name: Kansas

rates2026.note: K.S.A. 44-1203; the state law applies only to employers and employees not covered by the federal FLSA (which also requires $7.25).

minWage.smallEmployer: The Kansas minimum wage law excludes any employer subject to the federal FLSA; it covers only employers outside the FLSA, at the same $7.25.

tipped.note: Employer pays at least $2.13/hour and makes up the difference if wage plus tips is below $7.25.

minWage.other: The state law excludes, among others, agricultural and domestic workers and persons 18 or younger employed occasionally or part-time (K.S.A. 44-1202).

source.quote: on and after January 1, 2010, employee wages shall be paid at a rate of not less than $7.25 an hour. ... the employer shall pay a minimum wage of at least $2.13 an hour.

overtime.exemptSalaryNote: No state salary threshold above the federal $684/week.
overtime.note: Kansas state overtime starts after 46 hours a week and applies only to employees NOT covered by FLSA overtime; FLSA-covered employees get overtime after 40 hours under federal law.

source.quote: no employer shall employ any employee for a workweek longer than 46 hours, unless such employee receives compensation for employment in excess of 46 hours in a workweek at a rate of not less than 1 1/2 times

sickLeave.note: No state paid sick leave law; cities and counties are barred from requiring paid or unpaid leave beyond state or federal law (K.S.A. 12-16,130).

source.quote: No city, county or local government unit shall enact or administer any ordinance ... which requires an employer to: (1) Provide to such employer's employees any leave from work

finalPay.ptoNote: No statute requires payout of accrued vacation; it follows the employer's policy or contract.

source.quote: Whenever an employer discharges an employee or whenever an employee quits or resigns, the employer shall pay the employee's earned wages not later than the next regular payday
Kansas is not listed in the USDOL table of states with meal period requirements for adult private-sector employees.

rightToWorkSource.quote: Any person who is aggrieved by any violation of the provisions of section 12 of article 15 of the constitution of the state of Kansas shall have a cause of action

notes.text: Kansas state overtime kicks in only after 46 hours a week (not 40), and only for workers outside the federal FLSA.

source.quote: in excess of 46 hours in a workweek at a rate of not less than 1 1/2 times the hourly wage rate

notes.text: Cities and counties cannot set a higher minimum wage or require paid leave (K.S.A. 12-16,130, 2013).

source.quote: pay compensation or wages at any rate higher than the minimum wage unless the payment of higher compensation or wages is required by state or federal law

notes.text: An employer that willfully withholds final wages owes a penalty of 1% of unpaid wages per day after the eighth day, up to 100% of the wages.

source.quote: a penalty in the fixed amount of 1% of the unpaid wages for each day ... after the eighth day ... or in an amount equal to 100% of the unpaid wages, whichever is less.
